title: 第0019章低语乍现温泉区的失控者第0020章隐士授艺心灵初修
content_zh:
;;
凰溪岛的暮色，总是带着一层湿漉漉的咸腥气。
夕阳把度假区的琉璃瓦染成熔金，远处的废土边境线翻涌着灰黑色的雾霾，像是一头蛰伏的巨兽，隔着茫茫海域，静静盯着这座纸醉金迷的武者度假圣地。
贾黑米扛着半人高的清洁工具，快步走在凰溪温泉度假区的后街石板路上，额角的汗水顺着下颌线滴落，砸在青石板上，转瞬就被燥热的空气蒸干。
今天是他在温泉馆打零工的第七天。
作为土生土长的凰溪岛底层少年，贾黑米没有显赫的家世，没有充盈的气血，更没有觉醒人人羡慕的序列异能，在这座以武道实力论高低的小岛上，他就是最标准的“武道废柴”。
为了凑齐下个月武道高考预选的报名费，他不得不一天打三份工——清晨送气血营养液，中午在武道馆外围打扫训练场，傍晚则来温泉度假区做保洁，直到深夜才能拖着疲惫的身体回到岛上那间不足十平米的出租屋。
口袋里的气血测试仪微微发烫，屏幕上跳动的数字始终停在117赫。
成年武者的最低气血标准是150赫，参加武道高考预选的门槛更是200赫，而贾黑米今年已经二十岁，气血却连及格线都摸不到。
岛上的同龄人大多已经突破300赫，甚至有天才如才依依，早在半年前就突破了500赫，被岛内各大武道馆抢着收为核心弟子。
差距大到让人绝望。
贾黑米咬了咬牙，把脑海里那些自卑的念头强行压下去。
他不能放弃。
武道高考是底层少年唯一逆天改命的机会，一旦错过，他就只能像岛上那些无业流民一样，要么一辈子困在凰溪岛做最底层的苦力，要么被强制送往废土边境，成为异兽的口粮。
“贾黑米！磨磨蹭蹭干什么？三号温泉池的排水口堵了，赶紧去清干净！要是耽误了贵客修行，你十个月的工资都赔不起！”
尖锐的呵斥声从前方传来，温泉馆的主管王胖子腆着肚子，脸上的横肉随着动作抖动，眼神里满是鄙夷。
在他眼里，贾黑米这种气血孱弱的废物，连给贵客提鞋都不配。
“知道了，王主管。”贾黑米低声应道，没有多余的辩解，转身快步走向三号温泉区。
他早就习惯了这样的冷眼。
凰溪岛就是这样，实力就是尊严，没有气血，没有序列，就只能任人践踏。

三号温泉区是度假区的中高端区域，专供岛内武道馆的学员和外来的低阶武者使用，池水富含微量灵气，能缓慢滋养气血，是贾黑米平时连靠近都不敢的地方。
此刻天色渐暗，温泉区的暖黄色灯光次第亮起，水雾缭绕，看上去静谧又祥和。
贾黑米放下工具，蹲在三号池的排水口前，伸手去掏里面堵塞的落叶和砂石。指尖触到冰凉的池水，一股细微的、难以言喻的异样感突然顺着指尖窜进脑海。
像是有人在耳边用气声低语。
沙沙——
嘶啦——
声音细碎、模糊，像是隔着一层厚厚的水幕，又像是直接从灵魂深处响起，晦涩难懂，却带着一种莫名的蛊惑力，让人心里莫名烦躁、心慌。
贾黑米猛地甩了甩头，指尖的异样感瞬间消失，耳边的低语也随之不见。
“错觉吗？”
他揉了揉太阳穴，最近为了备考和打工，每天只睡三个时辰，精神恍惚也正常。
贾黑米没放在心上，继续清理排水口。可就在他把手伸进池水的瞬间，那诡异的低语再次响起，比刚才更加清晰，像是无数只虫子在耳膜里爬动。
“痛苦……绝望……臣服我……”
“你的弱小，你的自卑，都是原罪……”
“放弃吧，你永远都是废物……”
字字句句，精准戳中贾黑米内心最深处的伤疤。
气血孱弱、被人嘲笑、前途渺茫……那些他拼命压抑的负面情绪，在这一刻如同决堤的洪水，疯狂涌向心头。
贾黑米的脸色瞬间惨白，手指死死攥紧，指甲嵌进掌心，刺痛感让他勉强保持清醒。
他猛地抽回手，后退两步，靠在冰冷的石壁上，大口喘着粗气。

The dusk on Huangxi Island always carries a damp, salty smell.
The setting sun dyed the glazed tiles of the resort area into molten gold, and the gray-black haze billowed over the wasteland border in the distance, like a dormant giant beast, staring quietly at this luxurious resort for warriors across the vast sea.
Jia Heimi walked quickly on the cobblestone road in the back street of Huangxi Hot Spring Resort, carrying cleaning tools half a person's height. The sweat on his forehead dripped down his jawline and hit the bluestone floor, where it was evaporated by the hot air in an instant.
Today is the seventh day of his odd job at the hot spring resort.
As a young man born and raised at the bottom of Huangxi Island, Jia Heimi does not have a prominent family background, does not have abundant vitality, and has not awakened the sequence of abilities that everyone envies. On this small island where martial arts strength is the criterion, he is the most standard "martial arts loser."
In order to collect the registration fee for the preliminaries for the martial arts college entrance examination next month, he had to work three jobs a day - delivering qi and blood nutrient solution in the morning, cleaning the training ground outside the martial arts hall at noon, and cleaning the hot spring resort in the evening. It was not until late at night that he could drag his tired body back to the rental house on the island, which was less than ten square meters.
The gas and blood tester in my pocket was slightly hot, and the beating numbers on the screen always stopped at 117 Hz.
The minimum qi and blood standard for an adult warrior is 150 Hz, and the threshold for participating in the preliminaries for the martial arts college entrance examination is 200 Hz. However, Jia Heimi is twenty years old this year, but his qi and blood cannot even touch the passing line.
Most of the peers on the island have broken through 300 Hz, and there are even geniuses like Cai Yiyi, who broke through 500 Hz as early as half a year ago, and are eager to be accepted as core disciples by major martial arts gyms on the island.
The gap is despairingly large.
Jia Heimi gritted his teeth and suppressed the thoughts of inferiority in his mind.
He can't give up.
The martial arts college entrance examination is the only opportunity for a low-income young man to change his life. If he misses it, he will have no choice but to be like the unemployed refugees on the island. Either he will be trapped in Huangxi Island for the rest of his life as a coolie at the bottom, or he will be forcibly sent to the wasteland border to become the food of alien beasts.
"Jia Heimi! Why are you waiting so long? The drain outlet of the No. 3 hot spring pool is clogged. Go and clean it quickly! If you delay the distinguished guest's practice, you won't even be able to pay for it with ten months' salary!"
Sharp scoldings came from the front. Fatty Wang, the manager of the hot spring resort, had his belly bulging, the flesh on his face trembled with his movements, and his eyes were full of disdain.
In his eyes, a weak-blooded waste like Jia Heimi was not even worthy of carrying shoes for distinguished guests.
"I got it, Director Wang." Jia Heimi responded in a low voice, without any unnecessary excuses, turned around and walked quickly towards the No. 3 hot spring area.
He has long been accustomed to such cold looks.
This is the case on Huangxi Island. Strength is dignity. Without blood and sequence, you can only be trampled on by others.
The No. 3 hot spring area is a mid-to-high-end area in the resort. It is exclusively used by students from the island's martial arts gym and low-level warriors from outside. The water in the pool is rich in trace amounts of spiritual energy and can slowly nourish the blood. It is a place that Jia Heimi usually does not even dare to approach.
At this moment, the sky is getting dark, and the warm yellow lights in the hot spring area light up one after another, and the water mist is lingering, making it look quiet and peaceful.
Jia Heimi put down his tools, squatted in front of the drain outlet of Pool No. 3, and reached out to dig out the fallen leaves and gravel that were clogged inside. When his fingertips touched the cold pool water, a subtle, indescribable strange feeling suddenly entered his mind along his fingertips.
It was like someone was whispering breathlessly in my ear.
rustle——
Hiss——
The sound was thin and fuzzy, as if separated by a thick layer of water, or as if it sounded directly from the depths of the soul. It was obscure and difficult to understand, but it carried an inexplicable bewitching power, making people feel inexplicably irritable and panicked.
Jiahemi shook his head violently, and the strange feeling in his fingertips disappeared instantly, as did the whispers in his ears.
"Illusion?"
He rubbed his temples. Recently, in order to prepare for exams and work part-time, he only slept for three hours a day. It was normal for him to be in a trance.
Jia Heimi didn't take it to heart and continued to clean the drain.. But the moment he put his hand into the water, the strange whisper sounded again, clearer than before, like countless insects crawling in his eardrums.
"Pain...despair...surrender to me..."
"Your weakness and inferiority are all original sins..."
"Give up, you will always be a waste..."
Every word and every sentence accurately pokes the deepest scar in Jia Heimi's heart.
Weak blood, being laughed at, and having a bleak future...the negative emotions that he tried so hard to suppress were like a flood bursting into his heart at this moment.
Jia Heimi's face instantly turned pale, his fingers clenched tightly, and his nails dug into his palms. The stinging sensation made him barely stay awake.
He jerked his hand away, took two steps back, and leaned against the cold stone wall, breathing heavily.
